notes:
RE-CLASSIFICATION: component 6 was listed as "Capacitor" (bbox centre 242,290) but the drawn symbol is unmistakably an earth GROUND: one lead coming down at x~240 into three stacked horizontal bars of decreasing length at y~285/292/297 (verified at 12x and 6x). A capacitor has two equal parallel plates; this has three bars, shortening downward. It has therefore been re-classed to "GND" and its terminal list reduced from 2 to 1. This is the drawing's only ground reference, and it is what makes the bootstrap's own "0" labels on inductor 9 sensible. Component 5 (the real capacitor, "50mF") is two equal plates at y~190/197 - clearly different.
Net map (ladder/bridge, drawn almost perfectly rectilinear; every node checked at 16x):
n1 = top rail at y~162 running from the left corner (146,162) to the right corner (329,162): Resistor 4 top, Capacitor 5 top (T-junction with dot at (243,161)), Resistor 2 top.
n2 = left middle node (142,245), a T with the vertical continuing down: Resistor 4 bottom, Inductor 9 left, Resistor 3 top.
0  = centre node (240,243), a 4-way crossing carrying an unmistakable junction dot: Capacitor 5 bottom (down the centre column from the top rail), Inductor 9 right, Inductor 8 left, and the lead going down to GND 6. Every net touching a GND symbol is "0", so this whole node is "0".
n3 = right middle node (325,240), junction dot: Resistor 2 bottom, Inductor 8 right, Resistor 7 top.
n4 = left source node: Resistor 3 bottom down to V-DC 0 ("10V") + terminal at (139,308).
n5 = right source node: Resistor 7 bottom down to V-DC 1 ("20V") + terminal at (325,307).
n6 = bottom rail at y~345-350: V-DC 0 minus terminal down to (139,350), east along the rail to (326,345) and up into V-DC 1 minus terminal.
Judgment calls:
(a) There are no crossovers or hops anywhere in this drawing; all four interior nodes are plain T/cross junctions and three of them carry a visible dot. Nothing had to be inferred.
(b) Both V-DC symbols are drawn with "+" above the "-" bar inside the circle, so index 0 = top = plus, index 1 = bottom = minus.
(c) The long horizontal at y~132 (upper right), the vertical at x~5 (far left) and the horizontal at y~372 (lower left) are page-edge / scan artefacts of the original sheet, not wires: none of them touches any component lead, and they are outside every net. They were ignored.
(d) Two-terminal order is as drawn (vertical parts top-then-bottom, horizontal parts left-then-right); this does not affect any metric.
(e) No component is off-frame and none is unconnected.
